name: mark-translation
description: A browser extension for Chinese-English translation

scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/post-build.js firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome && node scripts/post-build.js chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package.js firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/package.js chrome
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/*.zip && echo '✅ Cleaned all packaged files'
scripts.dist: npm run clean && npm run package:all
